mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.session_id AS sessionId, m.content AS answer, m.use_local AS useLocal, m.confidence, m.feedback, m.write_back_status AS writeBackStatus, m.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT content FROM kb_chat_message WHERE session_id = m.session_id AND role = 'user' AND id < m.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS question FROM kb_chat_message m WHERE m.role = 'assistant' AND m.write_back_status = #{status} ORDER BY m.id DESC
